status_note: Reproduces on 12.0.0 with DuckDB 2.0.0; on Ibis main (6d40f963) the DuckDB compiler still has no `visit_TimeTruncate`. No upstream issue found.
title: DuckDB: `time.truncate()` compiles to `DATE_TRUNC` of a `TIME`, which fails to bind
summary: Ibis's DuckDB SQL for `TimeTruncate` is `DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', t)` of a TIME, which DuckDB has no overload for, so `t.time().truncate("h")` fails to bind on DuckDB.
repro: `ibis.to_sql(t.select(x=t.ts.time().truncate("h")), dialect="duckdb")` gives `DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', CAST("t0"."ts" AS TIME))`; DuckDB 2.0.0 raises `Binder Error: No function matches the given name and argument types 'date_trunc(STRING_LITERAL, TIME)'`.
handling: sverify's DuckDB SQL truncates a time of day on 1970-01-01 and casts back to TIME (`DuckDBDialect.time_trunc`). The coverage case "time truncate" is compared with Lean and the other engines rather than with Ibis's DuckDB SQL (`NO_DUCKDB_SQL` in `coverage_cases/temporal.py`).
